_comment: TizenHalo install-time settings. Copy to config.json in this folder to bake your own values into a build, or let the Apps2Samsung install form fill in the wledIp, ledCount, mapOffset, mapReverse and ppiZones lines below (keep their exact formatting). Values here are only the starting point: anything changed later on the settings page is saved on the TV and wins. Every key is optional; see docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
